component.name: DBased
component.summary: Clean Libadwaita GUI Database Client for MySQL and PostgreSQL

description.p: DBased is a lightweight, native Linux GUI database client built with Rust, GTK4, Libadwaita, and GtkSourceView 5. Designed around a clean GNOME aesthetic and keyboard-centric workflows, it combines a responsive spreadsheet data grid, schema and foreign-key management, built-in SSH bastion tunneling, and Vim-enabled editors for both SQL queries and multiline JSON/JSONB/text cells.
